user.title: Set up Energy Payback

data_description.categories: You can add more categories later on the integration page.

pv.title: PV plant
pv.description: From the energy dashboard: solar production, feed-in with compensation, grid import with electricity price. Only what Home Assistant does not know is asked here.

data_description.investment: What it cost. The card then shows how far it has paid for itself.
data_description.commissioned: Empty: from the beginning of the solar data ({data_since}). If the plant is older, enter the real date.

data_description.investment_entity: For example a number helper with the running sum of your expenses. When it is unavailable, the fixed amount counts.

heat_pump.title: Heat pump instead of a gas boiler
heat_pump.description: From the energy dashboard: grid import with electricity price. Saving: gas for the same heat, minus the heat pump's electricity.

data.investment: Extra cost over a gas boiler (optional)

data_description.meters: From the individual devices of the energy dashboard. Choose all that belong to it, for example heating and hot water.
data_description.scop: Only used without a heat meter, or before it was installed. Usually 3 to 4.5.
data_description.gas_price: What a kilowatt-hour of gas would cost today. Also used for the computed past.
data_description.investment: What it cost. The card then shows how far it has paid for itself.
data_description.commissioned: Empty: from the first data of the electricity meters.

data_description.boiler_efficiency: The share of the gas's energy that becomes heat.

data_description.gas_price_entity: For example a number helper or your supplier's price sensor. It takes precedence; when it is unavailable, the fixed price counts.
data_description.investment_entity: For example a number helper with the running sum of your expenses. When it is unavailable, the fixed amount counts.
data_description.grid: The grid connection whose price the device pays, for example a separate heat pump tariff.

wallbox.title: Electric car instead of a combustion car
wallbox.description: From the energy dashboard: grid import with electricity price. Saving: fuel for the same distance, minus the charging electricity.

data.investment: Extra cost over a combustion car (optional)

data_description.meters: From the individual devices of the energy dashboard. Choose all that belong to it, for example heating and hot water.
data_description.fuel_price: What a litre would cost today. Also used for the computed past.
data_description.investment: What it cost. The card then shows how far it has paid for itself.
data_description.commissioned: Empty: from the first charge in the data.

data_description.combustion_consumption: The car the electric car replaces. With several cars, an average.
data_description.ev_consumption: Measured at the wallbox, with charging losses. With several cars, an average.

data_description.fuel_price_entity: For example a number helper or a fuel price sensor. It takes precedence; when it is unavailable, the fixed price counts.
data_description.investment_entity: For example a number helper with the running sum of your expenses. When it is unavailable, the fixed amount counts.
data_description.grid: The grid connection whose price the device pays, for example a separate heat pump tariff.

error.commissioned_in_future: The date lies in the future.

abort.no_energy_dashboard: The energy dashboard has no grid import with an electricity price. Energy Payback calculates with them; please set them up in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy) first.
abort.nothing_to_evaluate: The energy dashboard has neither solar production nor individual devices. Add your PV plant, or the meters of your heat pump or wallbox, in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy) first.
abort.energy_interface: Energy Payback cannot read the energy dashboard of this Home Assistant version. Please look for an update of Energy Payback.

create_entry.default: The past is now being computed in the background; this usually takes less than a minute. Add the card "Energy Payback" from the card picker of any dashboard.

energy_interface.title: Energy Payback cannot read the energy dashboard
energy_interface.description: This version of Home Assistant stores the energy dashboard or its statistics in a way Energy Payback does not understand. The savings are unavailable until Energy Payback is updated.

no_grid_price.title: Energy Payback is missing the electricity price
no_grid_price.description: The energy dashboard has no grid import with an electricity price anymore. The savings keep their last values until it is set up again in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy).

missing_meter.title: {category}: meter missing in the energy dashboard
missing_meter.description: The energy dashboard no longer has: {meters}. {category} keeps its last figures until this is fixed. Add the meter back in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy), or choose other meters with Reconfigure on the integration page of Energy Payback.
